newsitem.title: USA: CompScript pact to boost 97 & 98 revenues.
newsitem.headline: CompScript pact to boost 97 & 98 revenues.

text.p: CompScript Inc said Tuesday it has signed a five-year agreement to provide mail order pharmacy services to Pharmacy Gold Inc patients.
The pact should generate $8 to $12 million in revenues in 1997 and about $20 to $25 million in annual revenues in 1998, with successive annual revenue increases thereafter, CompScript said.
The agreement begins January 1, CompScript said.
For the first nine months of 1996, CompScript reported $15.6 million in sales.
CompScript shares were unchanged late Tuesday morning at seven.
